title: Compact the selected-night header
summary: Changes and Breaks now reach the useful work sooner while giving the shared shift identity more visual presence.
changes: Changes and Breaks use a tighter institutional masthead with the information action aligned inside the title row instead of occupying a large empty area.
The shared shift identity is amplified with a larger fixed artwork stage, stronger name hierarchy and clearer tagline while the surrounding context takes less vertical space.
Selected-night date and staffing controls are consolidated into a compact context surface, allowing Manage this night and the break plan to appear higher on phone screens.
Breaks now establishes shift and selected-night context before the personal break card so the screen follows the same where, when, what hierarchy as the rest of the app.
